surface: Blind-signing elimination / clear-signing coverage (key=clearsign) — on-chain UserOp dispatcher (single + batch), off-chain EIP-1271 kinds (RAW32 / PERSONAL_SIGN / EIP712_TYPED / EIP712_TYPED_V3), Safe/CoW/ERC-7730/typed-call/ERC-20 decoders, known-call omission filter, forced-blind candidate, ERC-8213 fingerprints, mandatory envelope pages, trusted-UI consent gates. Read-only inventory, HEAD c75b0d9c on feat/pq1-board-target. EIP-7702 is OUT of scope by design (no EOA key; docs/feature-roadmap-research-2026-06.md:189) and is not treated as a gap.

has.item: Priority-ladder sign dispatcher: native CoW v3 > Safe v1 (approveHash) > Safe execTransaction > ERC-7730 (two-pass transcript) > known-call omission filter > value transfer > ERC-20 known > ERC-20 unknown > typed-call > loud blind sign
has.notes: Ordering documented as load-bearing; Safe surface wins over bare CoW so refund pages cannot be hidden (dispatch.rs:896-928). Any Err(()) from the ladder is a refuse-to-sign in the handler (cmd_sign_userop.rs:1559-1561).

has.item: Safe approveHash clear-sign: 8-step verifier (framing, selector, len==36, chain pin, safe-addr pin, operation gate, keccak(raw_data)==data_hash, recomputed safeTxHash==calldata[4..36])
has.notes: Inner SafeTx rendered via safe_display with refund worst-case bound pages (gasToken/gasPrice/refundReceiver) — safe_display.rs:1-80.

has.item: Safe execTransaction direct decode (no trailer): strict head length, canonical address words, operation in {0,1}, dynamic-tail framing; Kani-verified host crate pqsigner_tx::safe_tx
has.notes: Dual verify_and_bind_exec_into + CFI sentinels A/B in the handler.

has.item: Safe multiSend (MultiSendCallOnly DELEGATECALL) clear-sign: 3 pinned addresses, per-record op==0, <=6 records, strict ABI framing, per-record inner ladder, page-budget refuse-not-truncate via multisend_sign_gate
has.notes: operation=0 CALL to a MultiSend address deliberately stays on generic path (multi_send.rs:65-71). Matches CLAUDE.md claim.

has.item: Safe management ops (addOwnerWithThreshold/removeOwner/swapOwner/changeThreshold/enableModule/disableModule/setGuard/setFallbackHandler) decoded and rendered with full parameters when SafeTx.to == safe_address
has.notes: Pure logic in pqsigner_tx::safe_mgmt (Kani decode-soundness per shim doc).

has.item: Safe-wrapped CoW presign: one binding resolver (direct / approveHash / execTransaction / multiSend-record) requires uid.owner == the Safe and binds the v3 trailer to the exact 164-byte record; fail-closed by construction

CoW downgrade-mitigation gates: setPreSignature on GPv2 (direct or via verified Safe) REQUIRES a verified v3 order trailer; direct-path target must be GPv2; approveHash selector REQUIRES safe_v1 trailer (selector-only claim, closes the 37-byte parser differential)
has.notes: Same gates fire per inner-tx in the batch handler.

has.item: CoW GPv2Order decoded on-device; sell/buy token metadata Merkle-verified against ERC20_DB_ROOT; unknown/failed leg falls to AddrHex (address + raw amount), not a refusal
has.notes: CLAUDE.md's 'SELL 0.2 USDC for at least 0.0004 WETH' holds only for DB-known tokens; unknown tokens render as hex address legs.

has.item: ERC-7730 contract-call clear-signing: proof-set trailer Merkle-verified against firmware-pinned ERC7730_DESCRIPTORS_ROOT with canonical leaf-count enforcement (365 prod / 11 e2e), (chain,to) binding cross-check with FI-hardened A/B gates, two-pass render transcript proof, every verified-descriptor render error is a hard refusal
has.notes: 15 FormatOps incl. PQSigner-specific UniswapV3Path (pqsigner-erc7730/src/ir.rs:258-279); COMPACT_MODE=false pinned by const assert (render/mod.rs:374-391, #383).

has.item: Known-call omission filter: 16 KiB Bloom of every registry-declared (chain,contract,selector) incl. formats the strict renderer refuses; Bloom-positive without a bound descriptor hard-refuses ('7730 proof needed'); FI-hardened A/B gate; applies also to to=None via all-zero sentinel
has.notes: 4615 known tuples, 28646/131072 bits set, 25% hard cap (review.txt). Applies to contract calls only — there is NO analogous omission filter for EIP-712 typed data (see gaps).

has.item: ERC-7730 nested-calldata child proof (one level, proof-set trailer, derived child target/selector/interval, child binds to parent chain/target)
has.notes: Mechanism landed (#346 closed) but PRODUCTION_NESTED_CALLDATA_ENROLLMENTS is empty and the production catalogue has zero op=calldata formats; only the synthetic fixture (feature erc7730-nested-calldata-test-fixture) exercises it, and its 5 tests run in no CI suite (#724).

has.item: Native ERC-20 decode (transfer/transferFrom/approve, strict length + canonical address words) with Merkle-verified metadata (symbol/decimals) when (chain,contract)==tx.to; exact-amount renderability refusal; 'unlimited' approve label; unknown-token loud banner with raw uint256; transferFrom 'From (debited)' page
has.notes: ERC-721 approve(address,uint256) selector collision is acknowledged as indistinguishable (calldata.rs:7-10); for an unknown token a tokenId renders as an 'amount'.

has.item: Typed-call renderer (selector -> text_sig Merkle-verified against SELECTOR_DB_ROOT, strict two-pass ABI walk, <=6 args rendered, decline-and-fall-back to loud blind sign) plus self-attest selector path labelled 'GUESS:'
has.notes: Both selector trailers present => refuse. Self-attest has only 4-byte keccak provenance (#420 open owner decision). Banner stays '! BLIND SIGN' on typed-call pages — types trusted, semantics not.

has.item: Loud blind-sign fallback: '! BLIND SIGN / Unknown call / Verify on dapp' banner, full target, chain, data length, SHA-256 calldata rows, selector row, optional FUNCTION/GUESS page
has.notes: Reachable only after Bloom non-membership is proven (dispatch.rs:566).

has.item: Mandatory handler-owned envelope pages with CFI/transcript proofs: signer identity, target identity, native value (when !=0), paymaster warning, 192-bit nonce lane, UserOp gas triple, deployment-mode (initCode factory) page, legacy fee pages; each 'unshown'/'changed' is a refusal
has.notes: Reserved-page accounting feeds multisend_sign_gate so the 31-page budget fails closed (pqsigner-erc7730/src/display/mod.rs:74).

has.item: ERC-8213 two-page fingerprint appended on every companion-supplied signing path (CalldataDigest for UserOp/batch members, Eip712Final, Raw32 + ReplaySafeHash for RAW32, SafeTxHash), with completion proofs; Type-1 rotation consent is the documented sole exemption

Off-chain EIP-1271 kinds: RAW32(0), PERSONAL_SIGN(1), EIP712_TYPED(2), EIP712_TYPED_V3(3, nested-struct display witness); firmware (never companion) performs Solady replay-safe nesting for every kind; bootstrap ownerIndex 0 forbidden; unregistered slot refused except ERC-6492 slot-0 counterfactual
has.notes: RAW32 UserOp-forgery oracle fixed 2026-06-11 (replay_safe_hash on-device); CI runs the RAW32-forgery-oracle negative tests (ci.yml:218).

has.item: EIP-712 typed-data clear-signing (kind 2/3) requires an ERC-7730 EIP-712 descriptor bundle Merkle-verified against ERC7730_DESCRIPTORS_ROOT plus FI-hardened (chain_id, domain_separator) binding; field-level pages + Eip712Final fingerprint; render failure refuses (never falls to raw hash)
has.notes: Intent interpolation on EIP-712 formats is rejected ('7730 eip712 interpolation unsupported', render/mod.rs:1131-1133). Nested Permit2/UniswapX structs supported via V3 hashStruct binding (pqsigner-erc7730/src/display/render/nested.rs:1-30).

has.item: RAW32 loud blind tier: '! BLIND RAW32' banner, full supplied H AND full replay-safe signed hash both shown as ERC-8213 pages, context pages (chain/account/slot/signer/budget), ERC-6492 '! Undeployed sig' warning
has.notes: RAW32 is intentionally opaque — no semantic claim; disable-in-production is the stated preference (open owner decision #381). There is NO feature flag today that removes/gates RAW32 (grep of secure/Cargo.toml: none).

has.item: personal_sign rendering: message bytes paged 48 chars/page with 'Msg N/M' footer, non-printable/non-ASCII bytes replaced by '?', budget/gap row on final page
has.notes: Non-injective rendering (?-substitution, trailing whitespace, no byte length) is an open finding #154.

has.item: Batch sign (CMD 30): per-member pages through the same pick_sign_pages ladder, same per-member CoW/Safe downgrade gates, trailer kinds 1,3..8 routed by tx_idx, batch-wide name bundles, final 'Sign N txs?' gate with Raw32 batch fingerprint, MAX_BATCH_TXS=4, wire v2 only
has.notes: Forced-blind is explicitly excluded from batch (cmd_sign_userop_forced.rs:3-6).

has.item: Forced-blind (feature erc7730-forced-blind): terminal branch after ordinary classification; exact P73K refused-known set F=K\C (560 groups / 3290 tuples) + Bloom double-check; fixed 29-page raw transcript; PIN-armed single attempt; sign_rate limiter; two warning pages; receipts consumed once
has.notes: Default-off; in PROD_FORBIDDEN (Makefile:2675) and asserted forbidden (secure/src/main_sau_pure_tests.rs:1508); mode-production+forced-blind compile_error unless stm32u585+iwdg+ui-lcd (nsc/mod.rs:271-290); stays on the legacy page dialog not ui-px (confirm.rs:90, HARDENING.md:53). v1 architecture REJECTED; v2 awaits owner prompt-abuse decision + fresh dual review (#329). 14 of its guard-rail tests run in no CI suite (#724).

has.item: Descriptor catalogue provenance: P73S 256-byte status receipt embedded in firmware, provenance byte dev-unattested vs ERC-8176-verified; erc7730-dev-unattested feature is mutually exclusive with mode-production via compile_error; prod-erc7730-provenance-check Make gate; dbgen computes ERC-8176 keccak(JCS) hashes; DEV UNATTESTED warning page on dev builds
has.notes: Host verifier half exists; 0 of our descriptors are ERC-8176 attested; canonical catalogue is dev-unattested (ship-blocker #377).

has.item: dbgen curation: PQSigner-local fail-closed overlay (deploymentFormats allowlist, refusalOnlyFormats quarantine), strict-corpus dedup, Bloom occupancy cap, canonical review.txt with per-descriptor emitted semantics and skips
has.notes: EIP-712 descriptors without an explicit overlay keep the historical emit-all default (#534 open, low). dbgen/src/erc7730.rs is a 6,472-line single file (#356).

has.item: Address-name trailer: companion-supplied names Merkle-verified against NAMES_DB_ROOT; verified name shown with '+' sentinel plus a 6+6 hex address fingerprint row; chain id numeric always ground truth, chain label advisory
has.notes: QEMU e2e scenario 5w (name trailer) is a known failing regression (#469/#500).

has.item: Legacy 16x4 trusted-UI consent gate: long-right accepted only after the last page has actually been painted (FI-hardened seen_last in NavigationCore); long-left cancels
has.notes: Hint text 'R=Confirm' is hardcoded into value_transfer.rs:81-82 and shows on a non-final page (#714).
